aggressive_definition: New cases of advanced prostate cancer
aggressive_definition_excerpt: From 1989 through 1994, 181 new cases of advanced prostate cancer were reported.
study_design: Nested case-control study within the prospective Health Professionals Follow-Up Study
reason: The prospective nested case-control analysis explicitly evaluates newly reported advanced prostate cancer. The abstract does not report a separate total or general incident prostate cancer analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: When matched case-control data were analyzed, higher selenium levels were associated with a reduced risk of advanced prostate cancer (odds ratio [OR] for comparison of highest to lowest quintile = 0.49; 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.25-0.96; P for trend = .11).
estimate_classifications.reason: The selenium estimate pertains to explicitly advanced incident prostate cancer. The row's adjusted OR of 0.35 is subsequently reported for the same matched analysis.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
